facts.fact: The NIA says the National Identity Register Act, 2008 (Act 750), as amended, is the parent act under which L.I. 2523 was made, an act of Parliament.

The NIA says L.I. 2523 was signed and gazetted on 27 March 2026 under Section 73(1) of Act 750 and came into effect on 9 June 2026, requiring institutions that verify identity to use real-time biometric verification against the NIA database via the IVSP.
